main_text.p: & necessitas ad curandum morbum[illegible, ~8 letters] præsentem. sin lenientia mediocri-bus, aut vehementibus misceantur, compositi dosis non erit minor,quam singulorum seorsim.sin valida adjun-gantur mediocribus ; ad ea acuenda minui debet dosis vehementium, re-licta mediocrium usitata.

Porro quia basis est compositi medicamenti quasi anima , eius ad reli-qua ingredientia proportio diligen-ter est confideranda , nec unquam commitendum ut vehementia mag-na copia basi adjungantur.ergo basis vehemens,minorem exigit quantita-tem , debilis vero maiorem : verum corrigentia,quæ vel augent , vel mi-nuunt vim basis,in minore, quam ea, sumi oportet. at quæ corrigunt basis maligunitatem , proprietate. aliqua æquare eam debent. Quod ad diri-gentia attinet;si basis magna sit quã-titas (ut in medicamentis debilibus) dirigentium minor debet esse quan-titas.sin basis sit vehemens,ac proin-de parvæ quantitatis,ut colocynthis;

page.notes: The right-hand margin carries faint, cropped marginal notes (fragments such as "dirigentium", "De formis", "tres regni") which are too blurred to transcribe reliably; the single illegible marker above stands for them only in part. The catchword "diri-" is taken as the catchword of the page. Long s has been rendered as plain s throughout, and u/v, i/j normalised.
